column3: Saori Route ・ Penetrated into the Heart
Kyousuke-shi...
I won't allow you to just say "Goodbye".
But, there's nothing else left to say.
I still do, even if you don't!
That earnest part is what's so good about you.
You're softhearted, meddlesome, and will be straightforward with anyone...
If only I could act that recklessly...
If it's you, it's possible!
Impo...ssible.
...My legs have already stopped, and I can no longer move.
If you can't move, you have to force yourself to move!
If you brace your legs and put force into your knees, you can go anywhere.
Hahaha, if I did that, I would break.
You are considering my feelings and staying silent...
You really are a kind person.
I can definitely tell by looking at Saori that she's worn out. She may break if she overdoes it...
But, if she goes on like this, she will definitely break one day...!
Hm? Is something the matter, Kyousuke-shi?
If we stop now, sooner or later, it will end the same way, right?
Hey, I won't understand anything if you stay silent.
Sorry, Kyousuke-shi...
Ah, I mean... You don't have to apologize...
No, I understand that you cannot just give away these feelings...
In other words, she won't change her mind... Damn!
...You can't think of anything to say, huh. I get it.
I don't know what to tell you as well.
Hoho? There are also times where you are at a loss for words?
Isn't that obvious?
Rather, I believe I'm worse at talking than you.
Than I? ...Of course not!
No, no, no, you are amazing with words.
You explained otaku stuff to me, a guy who didn't know anything about it, in an easy-to-understand way...
And you can resolve the conflicts between Kirino and Kuroneko when they start arguing right upon seeing each other, right?
Kyousuke-shi! You are giving me too much praise...!
It's not just that.  I can't count how many times you have helped us out.
That is not...
It is true. You saved us.
Think, Kyousuke. I have to have a plan.
If you have nothing to say, I will be going now.
I have to do preparations for becoming a bride!
Wait, don't become a bride, Saori!
Haven't you heard that marriage is the graveyard of life? You don't know what'll happen.
If it is him, then he will certainly bring me happiness.
A man who denies his fiancee's hobbies?
...You can't think of what to say, huh. I get it.
I don't know what to tell you as well.
Hoho? There are also times where you are at a loss for words?
Isn't that obvious?
Rather, I believe I'm worse at talking than you.
Than I? ...Of course not!
No, no, no, you are amazing with words.
You explained otaku stuff to me, a guy who didn't know anything about it, in an easy-to-understand way...
And you can resolve the conflicts between Kirino and Kuroneko when they start arguing right upon seeing each other, right?
Kyousuke-shi! You are giving me too much praise...!
It's not just that.  I can't count how many times you have helped us.
That is not...
It is true. You saved us.
It's useless. I can't save anyone...
I do not want you saying things like that.
Even if you tell me not to...
In a marriage interview, both sides need to agree.
Kiririn-shi hates me now, and I do not know what Kuroneko-shi will say...
At least... I want you to congratulate me...
I can't just do that...
Why?
Because I've seen your pained face.
...But, I have already reached the conclusion.
It appears that my otaku route has come to an end.
Then just do it again!
Reload the data!  You can even reset or reboot!
Don't say such absurd stuff, Kyousuke-shi.
Reality and games are different.
You're right. Reality and games are different.
If you know, then why did you say that?
Just because you can't restart doesn't mean you should give up that easily.
Can you even enjoy yourself in a life that you don't even agree with?
Are you sure you're okay with that?
I have already told you many times.
There is nothing else left to do...
Why!? You're pushing yourself into a corner!
Then, let me ask you.
Are you telling me to be selfish?
Betray my parents and fiance for myself? Do nothing about the restrictions on anime, games and manga? Cause trouble to my beloved friends?
Is this what you want to say?
Yes, that's it.
My parents, fiance, and my beloved anime, games, and manga, besides-
I cannot cause any more trouble for my precious friends.
That's what I mean! Stop thinking like that!
Okay, it is about time for me to...
Wait wait wait wait!
Hey! Do not stop me! If I do not go, I will be a shame of a woman!!
If you go, you'll be a shame of an otaku! Don't just simply give up on life!
But, it looks like my otaku route scenario has reached the end.
Your otaku route scenario...?
I am also ending the princess route, the eloping route, and all kinds of other routes!
Stop messing around!!
...Kyousuke-shi?
Don't make your life out to be some game!
We're human because we don't get a second chance, right? In our one life, we have one chance to enjoy it to the fullest.
Yet, why are you so easily throwing it all away...?
B-But, if you do that...
All my relationships might get severed.
I-It is possible... I-I could end up alone...
You won't, idiot! Just realize this already!
No matter who becomes your enemy, I will always be with you.
Kyo-Kyousuke-shi...!?
You might think it's fine like this, but without you, our relationships would change.
I don't believe thinking about people first is a bad thing.
However, you won't be able to get happiness for yourself that way!
Fufu... Just kidding...
If you think about it, I am already mostly alone...
But, this is something already decided on by my parents and I.
...No, not with just my parents.
It involves my fiance too, and you guys as well. I'm coming close to my decision.
Rather than pushing my own way, things might be solved by removing one person... Me...
I am fine being alone.
You're not alone! I'm here, right?
And, being forgotten right in front of your eyes... I'm really sad about that.
W-Wait...I did not mean it like that...
I understand you valuing your human relations.
But, without you, what about our relationship?
U-Umm...
More than that, you can't protect your happiness.
My happiness...
Yes, your happiness.
B-But, if I am happy, other people won't be...
That's not enough reason for you to give up.
It's not about other people, it's about what you want to do...right?
I don't want to live a life with the shame of causing others trouble...
That's why I will quit my otaku life and start my married one.
I won't let you end it here!
Kyo-Kyousuke-shi! You're too loud!
Shut up! Does that have anything to do with this?!
The one being noisy is you, right?!
Hmmm...
What is with that serious look...
...Just now, you talked back to me for the first time, right?
...And?
So you can express your opinion after all.
Just tell your fiance your true feelings like that. Go for it.
Kyousuke-shi...
Well then, it looks as if this conversation is over-
Wait, it isn't over yet.
...Still? what?
You're going to say you're alone, even though I'm in front of you...?
Ah... n-no...
By no means am I treating you like air.
If you did, I would cry. I would flail and wail about with snot all over my face.
D-Don't do that here!
Then, won't you think it over once more?
If you go, it will change Kirino's and my world.
But...
Is it really useless now?
Are you giving up because you think it is useless?
...Yes.
This is a dead end. You could say it is game over.
I don't think so. Your story doesn't end here.
Just... stop. An end is an end.
Are you trying to get me to hate you this time? To try to leave me out of this...
Hey, won't you at least listen... just a bit longer?
